text: Assumption: When HandleError is called, the passed ShwaErrorCode is converted into an ara::core::ErrorCode and forwarded to the callback function registered in Create — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: When HandleError is called, the passed ShwaErrorCode is converted into an ara::core::ErrorCode and forwarded to the callback function registered in Create — is this correct?
norm: when handleerror is called the passed shwaerrorcode is converted into an ara core errorcode and forwarded to the callback function registered in create
assumption: When HandleError is called, the passed ShwaErrorCode is converted into an ara::core::ErrorCode and forwarded to the callback function registered in Create.
rationale: Create takes std::function<void(ara::core::ErrorCode)>, while HandleError processes ShwaErrorCode; the specification does not detail the internal coupling.

original.text: Annahme: Beim Aufruf von HandleError wird der übergebene ShwaErrorCode vermutlich in einen ara::core::ErrorCode gewandelt und an die in Create registrierte Callback-Funktion weitergeleitet — trifft das zu?
